title: RetrievalResult
description: A single scored chunk returned by packages/legal_retrieval's hybrid search, before it becomes a Citation in an Answer. Not yet implemented in code (app/retrieval/ is empty) — this is the target shape; update it to match once legal_retrieval exists, and prefer generating it from a real pydantic model at that point instead of hand-authoring.

citation.description: Mirrors documents.citation for the parent document.

vector_score.description: Cosine similarity from the pgvector HNSW search leg, null if this result only matched full-text.

fts_score.description: ts_rank/ts_rank_cd from the Postgres FTS leg, null if this result only matched vector search.

fused_score.description: Combined hybrid score (e.g. reciprocal rank fusion) used for final ranking.
